hunks.baseline: I’d thought there was no way.

hunks.baseline: The unease I felt at that one short sentence over the phone had turned out to be exactly right.
hunks.sol: But the unease I’d felt at those few words over the phone had been right on the mark.

hunks.baseline: We followed the coordinates Magic Johnson had given us as quickly as possible, and after attempting several long-distance Teleports in succession, we arrived at a snow-covered mountain, its surroundings bleached white.
hunks.sol: We headed for the coordinates Magic Johnson had given us as fast as we could. After several long-distance Teleports in succession, we arrived on a mountain blanketed in white.

hunks.baseline: The everlasting snow covering the ground crumbled beneath my feet.
hunks.sol: The snow that had lain there for ages crumbled beneath my feet.

hunks.baseline: The breathtaking scenery of the Alps, something I had only ever seen on the internet, unfolded before my eyes. But I had no time to admire the view.
hunks.sol: The Alps stretched out before me, a sight I’d only ever seen on the internet. I had no time to admire it.

hunks.baseline: “Hold! Hold!”
hunks.sol: “Stop! Stop!”

hunks.baseline: At the urgent shouts, gun barrels and blades were pointed at us.
hunks.sol: At their urgent shouts, gun barrels and blades swung toward us.

hunks.baseline: The soldiers and Hunters were heavily armed at a glance. Just as I stopped walking, a familiar voice came from among them.
hunks.sol: The soldiers and Hunters were heavily armed. I stopped, and a familiar voice came from among them.

hunks.baseline: “If you insist on attacking, I won’t stop you. But before you do, it would be in your best interest to check the intruders’ faces.”
hunks.sol: “If you insist on attacking, I won’t stop you. But it would be in your best interest to check the intruders’ faces first.”

hunks.baseline: “Take one more step and you’ll be shot immediately… Mr. Johnson?”
hunks.sol: “One more step and we shoot… Mr. Johnson?”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t act rashly, Colonel. They’re guests I invited.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t act rashly, Colonel. They’re my guests.”

hunks.baseline: A massive Black man passed by the middle-aged commander in a beret and stood before us.
hunks.sol: A huge Black man walked past the middle-aged commander in a beret and stopped before us.

hunks.baseline: His face was deeply marked by fatigue and sorrow.
hunks.sol: Fatigue and sorrow weighed on his face.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson, whom I had not seen for several weeks—no, several months—gave us a faint smile and greeted us.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson, whom I hadn’t seen for weeks—no, months—gave us a weary smile.

hunks.baseline: I smacked my lips bitterly and firmly grasped the hand he held out.
hunks.sol: I pressed my lips together, then gripped the hand he offered.

hunks.baseline: “Not at all.”
hunks.sol: “Not well at all.”

hunks.baseline: “Who are the people outside? There seemed to be an even split between soldiers and Hunters.”
hunks.sol: “Who are the people outside? It looked like an even split between soldiers and Hunters.”

hunks.baseline: “They’re the Swiss Federal Police. This area is under their jurisdiction as well, and I contacted them because I wanted to avoid being treated as a murder suspect simply because I was the first person to discover the body. Come with me.”
hunks.sol: “Swiss Federal Police. This area’s under their jurisdiction, and I didn’t want to become a murder suspect just because I found the body first. Come on.”

hunks.baseline: We passed between the soldiers and Hunters watching us with wary and curious eyes, then entered a forest buried beneath thick snow. A faint sense of déjà vu washed over me.
hunks.sol: We passed between the soldiers and Hunters watching us with equal parts wariness and curiosity, then entered a forest deep in snow. A faint sense of déjà vu stirred.

hunks.baseline: I closed my eyes and focused my mind. When I slowly extended a hand, I could feel an invisible ripple amid the fierce snowstorm.
hunks.sol: I closed my eyes and focused. As I slowly reached out, I felt an invisible ripple through the fierce snowstorm.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson nodded at my murmur.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson nodded.

hunks.baseline: “It’s a barrier. It’s hidden well enough to escape even most S-rank Hunters’ notice, and it’s every bit as flawless.”
hunks.sol: “A barrier. Concealed well enough that even most S-rank Hunters wouldn’t notice it, and just as flawless as it is discreet.”

hunks.baseline: There was not a hint of exaggeration in his explanation.
hunks.sol: He wasn’t exaggerating.

hunks.baseline: Even the Skeleton King had only barely noticed the barrier after hearing him point it out.
hunks.sol: Even the Skeleton King had barely noticed the barrier until Johnson pointed it out.

hunks.baseline: “Not bad for the work of humans. But it is still insufficient to deceive this body’s keen gaze. That is because I am not some ordinary S-rank Hunter, but an exceptionally gifted—”
hunks.sol: “Impressive work for a human. But not enough to fool this body’s keen gaze. After all, I am no ordinary S-rank Hunter. I am an exceptionally gifted—”

hunks.baseline: “A monster.”
hunks.sol: “Monster.”

hunks.baseline: After shutting him up with a single word, I stared at the barrier before me and recalled something that had happened not long ago.
hunks.sol: Having shut him up with one word, I studied the barrier and recalled something from not long ago.

hunks.baseline: Just as a particular martial art left behind a specific trace, magic worked the same way.
hunks.sol: Just as certain martial arts left distinct traces, so did magic.

hunks.baseline: Looking at the mana currents, as distinct as fingerprints, I became certain.
hunks.sol: The flow of mana was as distinctive as a fingerprint. I was sure of it.

hunks.baseline: *There’s no doubt. It feels just like it did in A Area.*
hunks.sol: *No doubt about it. It feels like A Area.*

hunks.baseline: As if he had read the thought that had flashed through my mind, Magic Johnson met my eyes and spoke.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson met my eyes, as if he’d read my mind.

hunks.baseline: “Even before this incident, I had been looking for people connected to A Area at your request. But among the people I know, only one person came to mind.”
hunks.sol: “I’d been looking for people connected to A Area at your request, even before all this happened. But of everyone I know, only one person came to mind.”

hunks.baseline: The identity of that person—the great Grand Mage who had designed A Area—was something I now knew as well.
